require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'

module CircuitBreaker
  STATES = %i[closed open half_open].freeze
  FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 5
  RESET_TIMEOUT = 30

  class Breaker
    attr_reader :state, :failure_count, :last_failure_time

    def initialize
      @state = :closed
      @failure_count = 0
      @last_failure_time = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :open
        if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= RESET_TIMEOUT
          @mutex.synchronize { @state = :half_open }
          try_request(&block)
        else
          raise CircuitOpenError, "Circuit is open"
        end
      when :closed, :half_open
        try_request(&block)
      end
    end

    private

    def try_request(&block)
      result = block.call
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count = 0
        @state = :closed
      end
      result
    rescue StandardError => e
      record_failure
      raise e
    end

    def record_failure
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count += 1
        @last_failure_time = Time.now
        @state = :open if @failure_count >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD
      end
    end
  end

  class CircuitOpenError < StandardError; end
end

class User
  ASSIGNABLE_ATTRS = %i[name email avatar_url timezone locale].freeze
  ADMIN_ATTRS = %i[role permissions api_quota tier].freeze
  ALL_ATTRS = (ASSIGNABLE_ATTRS + ADMIN_ATTRS).freeze

  attr_accessor *ALL_ATTRS
  attr_reader :id, :password_digest

  def initialize(attrs = {})
    @id = SecureRandom.uuid
    safe_assign(attrs, context: :create)
  end

  def update(attrs, context: :user)
    safe_assign(attrs, context: context)
  end

  def safe_assign(attrs, context: :user)
    permitted = permitted_attrs(context)
    attrs.each do |key, value|
      sym_key = key.to_sym
      send(:"#{sym_key}=", value) if permitted.include?(sym_key)
    end
  end

  def set_password(plain)
    @password_digest = BCrypt::Password.create(plain)
  end

  private

  def permitted_attrs(context)
    case context
    when :admin
      ALL_ATTRS
    when :user
      ASSIGNABLE_ATTRS
    when :create
      ASSIGNABLE_ATTRS
    else
      ASSIGNABLE_ATTRS
    end
  end
end

class FileProcessingService
  def initialize
    @breaker = CircuitBreaker::Breaker.new
    @processing_queue = []
  end

  def process_user_update(file_content, current_user, requesting_user_role)
    @breaker.call do
      payload = parse_file(file_content)
      validate_payload!(payload)

      context = determine_context(requesting_user_role)
      batch_updates = extract_batch_updates(payload)

      batch_updates.map do |update_entry|
        apply_update(current_user, update_entry, context)
      end
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_file(content)
    JSON.parse(content, symbolize_names: true)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid file format: #{e.message}"
  end

  def validate_payload!(payload)
    raise ArgumentError, "Missing updates key" unless payload.key?(:updates)
    raise ArgumentError, "Updates must be array" unless payload[:updates].is_a?(Array)
    raise ArgumentError, "Too many updates" if payload[:updates].length > 100
  end

  def determine_context(role)
    role == 'admin' ? :admin : :user
  end

  def extract_batch_updates(payload)
    payload[:updates].map do |entry|
      normalize_update_entry(entry)
    end
  end

  def normalize_update_entry(entry)
    attrs = entry[:attributes] || entry[:attrs] || {}
    filter_to_safe_keys(attrs)
  end

  def filter_to_safe_keys(attrs)
    safe = User::ASSIGNABLE_ATTRS
    attrs.select { |k, _v| safe.include?(k.to_sym) }
  end

  def apply_update(user, update_entry, context)
    user.update(update_entry, context: context)
    { status: 'success', user_id: user.id }
  rescue StandardError => e
    { status: 'error', message: e.message }
  end
end
